name: xileades
description: Open PowerShell + Claude toolkits for French business APIs — Qonto, PayFit and Pennylane — built for multi-company groups. Each plugin ships a library, skills and a pitfalls catalogue paid for in production.

plugins.name: qonto-api-toolkit
plugins.description: Qonto Business API across several companies: one key per organization, group balances, transactions, statements, pagination and rate limits. Read-only.

plugins.name: payfit-api-toolkit
plugins.description: PayFit partner API with a customer API key: companies, collaborators, absences, contracts, and the safety rules that keep payroll reads from turning into payroll writes.

plugins.name: pennylane-api-toolkit
plugins.description: Pennylane Company API v2 in a multi-company setup: access layer, supplier and customer invoices, bank reconciliation (lettrage), accounting exports (FEC, ledger, trial balance) and read-only analysis.
